no-restricted-syntax.message: snake_case fields are not allowed in type definitions. Use camelCase instead. Convert at API boundary using ApiBoundaryHelpers.
UUID-Only Policy: Do not use .eq('email') - use UUID for lookups
UUID-Only Policy: Do not match users by email - use UUID (user.id === message.authorId)
UUID-Only Policy: Do not use x-user-email header - use x-user-id only

Window Usage Policy (RED-LINE): Do not assign to window object. Use ES6 exports/imports or StateManager instead. See .cursorrules 'Window Object Usage Policy' section.
Window Usage Policy (RED-LINE): Do not use window.currentUser. Use stateManagerInstance.getState('currentUser') or authManagerInstance.getCurrentUser() instead.
Window Usage Policy (RED-LINE): Do not use window.api. Import api from './APIModule.js' instead.
Window Usage Policy (RED-LINE): Do not use window.currentVisibilityData. Use stateManagerInstance.getState('currentVisibilityData') instead.
Window Usage Policy (RED-LINE): Do not use window.currentVisibilityDataUnfiltered. Use stateManagerInstance.getState('currentVisibilityDataUnfiltered') instead.
Window Usage Policy (RED-LINE): Do not use window.currentUrlData. Use stateManagerInstance.getState('currentUrlData') instead.
Window Usage Policy (RED-LINE): Do not use window.supabase. Import Supabase client via ES6 imports instead.
Window Usage Policy (RED-LINE): Do not use window.supabaseRealtimeClient. Use ES6 module exports/imports instead.
Window Usage Policy (RED-LINE): Do not use window globals for application functions. Import these functions via ES6 imports instead.
Window Usage Policy (RED-LINE): Do not assign functions to window. Export them from modules and import via ES6 instead.
